mapper.select: SELECT r.*, h.hospital_name, v.plate_number, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(s2.staff_name SEPARATOR ',') FROM waste_staff s2 WHERE FIND_IN_SET(s2.staff_no, r.staff_nos)) AS staff_names FROM waste_record r LEFT JOIN waste_hospital h ON r.hospital_no = h.hospital_no LEFT JOIN waste_vehicle v ON r.vehicle_no = v.vehicle_no WHERE r.id = #{id}
SELECT * FROM waste_record WHERE hospital_no = #{hospitalNo} ORDER BY record_date DESC, create_time DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT MAX(batch_no) FROM waste_record WHERE batch_no LIKE CONCAT(#{datePrefix}, '%')
SELECT MAX(batch_no) FROM waste_record WHERE batch_no LIKE CONCAT(#{datePrefix}, '%') FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO waste_record (batch_no, hospital_no, region, vehicle_no, staff_nos, infectious_weight, injurious_weight, pharmaceutical_weight, chemical_weight, pathological_weight, total_weight, record_date, created_by) VALUES (#{batchNo}, #{hospitalNo}, #{region}, #{vehicleNo}, #{staffNos}, #{infectiousWeight}, #{injuriousWeight}, #{pharmaceuticalWeight}, #{chemicalWeight}, #{pathologicalWeight}, #{totalWeight}, #{recordDate}, #{createdBy})
